name: Passrate Tracker
description: Tracks your passrate for various runs

prev-target-key.name: Previous target
prev-target-key.description: Move the target to the previous start position (if possible).

next-target-key.name: Next target
next-target-key.description: Move the target to the next start position / the ending. (If keybinds stop working try restarting the game)

text-opacity.name: Opacity
text-opacity.description: Opacity of the text shown while playing (0-255).

grace-period.name: Grace period
grace-period.description: How many seconds long an attempt has to be before it is counted, so instant deaths don't skew down passrate. Set to 0 to turn off.

custom-ending-percent.name: Custom ending percent
custom-ending-percent.description: Runs to this percent get counted as if they were to 100% (so you don't have to sit through an end screen for the attempt to count as a pass).

lambda-slow.name: Passrate sensitivity
lambda-slow.description: How fast old attempts decay. Higher -> more stable, but slower changes. Lower -> more sensitive, fast changes to passrate, but more noisy. See more info in the in-level pause menu setting screen.

lambda-fast.name: Passrate trend sensitivity
lambda-fast.description: Like passrate sensitivity, but supposed to be more sensitive, so it can give a trend (are your RECENT attempts better / worse / the same). See more info in the in-level pause menu setting screen.

lambda-fast-text.name: Trend indicator
lambda-fast-text.description: Text that displays if your recent attempts have been better / worse / the same. The part that uses passrate trend sensitivity.

enable-tracker.name: Enable Passrate Tracker
enable-tracker.description: Disable this to turn off the label while playing and disable tracking. Can be done from within a level.

prune-data.description: Deletes saved passrate data for every level that doesn't have "whitelisted" enabled
